method: Color is converted in linear light through CIE XYZ with the D65 white point shared by all three gamuts. The input code is divided by its full scale and decoded with the selected curve: sRGB uses 12.92 v below 0.04045 and 1.055 v^(1/2.4) - 0.055 above; the BT.709 OETF, which is also the BT.2020 10-bit OETF, uses 4.5 L below 0.018 and 1.099 L^0.45 - 0.099 above; BT.1886 is a pure 2.4 gamma; linear passes the value through. Each RGB-to-XYZ matrix is derived at load from the space primary chromaticities and D65 white (x = 0.3127, y = 0.3290) by scaling the primary XYZ columns so RGB 1,1,1 lands on white with Y = 1. That derivation reproduces the standard sRGB matrix and the BT.2087 BT.709-to-BT.2020 matrix to the precision those references publish. Target linear RGB is INVERSE(target) x SOURCE applied to the source linear RGB, re-encoded with the same curve and reported as 8-bit and 10-bit codes, percent of full scale, linear RGB, XYZ, xy chromaticity and luminance Y. A target channel outside 0 to 1 by more than 5e-7 marks the color as outside the target gamut: the unclipped percentages, each channel deviation and the clipped codes are reported and no gamut mapping is applied. Inputs must be whole 8-bit or 10-bit codes or a percentage from 0 to full scale; comma decimals are accepted and exponent notation is refused. Black leaves chromaticity undefined. The page treats all three spaces as display-referred D65 RGB and does not model camera logs, HDR transfers, ICC profiles, cinema P3 white or dithering. Everything runs in the browser with no storage, uploads or network access.

sources.title: ITU-R BT.709 defines the Rec.709 primaries, the D65 white point, and the OETF constants 4.5, 0.018, 1.099 and 0.45 used here.
ITU-R BT.2020 defines the UHDTV primaries and white point, and its 10-bit OETF shared with BT.709.

W3C CSS Color 4 defines the sRGB, Display P3 and Rec.2020 color spaces with their primaries, D65 white point and transfer functions, and publishes the sRGB linear RGB to XYZ matrix used as a check here.
ITU-R BT.2087 gives the color conversion from BT.709 to BT.2020 and its published 3x3 matrix, used as an independent check of the conversion chain.
